label: ASHLAR · Prologue · The Old Face (hầm xương)
coordinateSystem: three.js right-handed, Y up. x = east, z = south (toward the default camera, which looks north), y = height; the dry floor is y = 0, the flooded basin -0.4, the water surface -0.18, the stair landing +1.8.
rotation: rotationEulerDeg = Euler angles in degrees in the stated order (three.js Euler order "YXZ": yaw about +Y first, then tilt about X). yawDeg = rotation about +Y (a piece's front = local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw)).
transform: wall modules: world matrix = compose(position, quaternion(Euler YXZ(tilt, yaw, 0)), scale(sx, sy, 1)) * the crypt-wall GLB (4 m wide, 2.283 m tall, 0.697 m deep, front face +z, pivot bottom centre). Props: compose(position, yaw, uniform scale) * GLB (position.y = floor height - 0.02 sink). The lab GLBs are the ASHLAR source GLBs rescaled by labFromOptimized.uniformScale (see assets); an optimized GLB in the source frame needs scaleForOptimizedGlb instead of scale.

labFromOptimized.horizontalExtents: no quarter turn (yaw 0 or 180 deg, plus small squaring-up yaws)
labFromOptimized.note: lab GLB = uniform scale k of the optimized (source-frame) GLB, baked yaw, re-pivoted to the bottom centre of the bbox; the lab bbox sizes are in labBbox, the optimized in optBbox. Yaw offsets that bbox sizes cannot show (180 deg, small squaring yaws) are NOT recovered: compare visually.
